items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the structure morphism of a gerbe over a base is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 6286-6291, label lemma-gerbe-fppf). The proof (source lines 6293-6316) reduces by the descent statements and the local structure of gerbes to the case of a quotient stack, where the covering of the quotient has the three properties and their permanence gives them for the structure morphism (proof lines 6293-6315). The reduction to a quotient stack is the substance. H3.
